dwarf.t:
n. 矮子, 侏儒
v. (使)变矮小
dwarf.d:
n. a person who is markedly small
n. a plant or animal that is atypically small

dwarfed.t: vt. （使）显得矮小（dwarf的过去式与过去分词形式）
dwarfed.d:
v make appear small by comparison
v check the growth of

dwarfish.t: a. 象侏儒的, 矮小的

dwarfism.d: n. a genetic abnormality resulting in short stature

dweeb.d: n an insignificant student who is ridiculed as being affected or boringly studious

dwell.t: vi. 居住, 居住(于), 存在(于)
dwell.d:
v. originate (in)
v. exist or be situated within

dweller.d: n a person who inhabits a particular place

dwelling.d: n. housing that someone is living in

dwindle.t:
vi. 减少, 缩小, 衰落
vt. 使缩小
dwindle.d: v. become smaller or lose substance

dwindling.t:
a. 逐渐减少的
v. 逐渐变少或变小( dwindle的现在分词 )
dwindling.d:
n. a becoming gradually less
s. gradually decreasing until little remains
